name: Fujian Mahjong
description: Fujian Mahjong refers to regional Mahjong play in China's Fujian province with local scoring conventions layered on top of standard draw-discard meld play. Games typically follow the familiar wall draw and discard-claim rhythm while using table profiles for what qualifies as a winning hand and how value is computed.

content.text: Fujian Mahjong refers to regional Mahjong play in China's Fujian province with local scoring conventions layered on top of standard draw-discard meld play. Games typically follow the familiar wall draw and discard-claim rhythm while using table profiles for what qualifies as a winning hand and how value is computed.
Fujian Mahjong developed from Chinese Mahjong traditions as local table rules spread through home and community play in Fujian.
